user.title: Set up a BRU tea maker
user.description: On the tea maker, open **Machine setup → Pair new device**. Then select it below.

no_devices.title: No tea maker found
no_devices.description:
Home Assistant cannot see a BRU tea maker that is not set up yet.

- Check that the tea maker is switched on.
- Move it closer to Home Assistant or to a Bluetooth proxy.
- Close the BRU app on your phone. While it is connected, the tea maker may not be visible.
- Tea makers that are already set up are not listed.

Press **Submit** to search again.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description:
Set up **{name}**?

On the tea maker, open **Machine setup → Pair new device**. Then press **Submit**.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description:
**{name}** needs to be paired again.

On the tea maker, open **Machine setup → Pair new device**. Then press **Submit**.

confirm_code.title: Confirm the pairing code
confirm_code.description:
The tea maker should now be showing this code:

## {code}

1. Check that the code on the tea maker matches.
2. Accept it **on the tea maker's screen**.
3. Press **Submit** here.

Do both within about 30 seconds of the code appearing.

proxy_info.title: Reached through a Bluetooth proxy
proxy_info.description:
Home Assistant reaches **{name}** through the Bluetooth proxy **{proxy}**. A standard ESPHome proxy cannot pair with the tea maker.

If you have not done so yet, add this to the proxy's ESPHome configuration and install it:

```yaml
esp32_ble:
  io_capability: keyboard_display
  auth_req_mode: sc_mitm_bond
  max_connections: 4

ble_client:
  - mac_address: {address}
    id: bru
    auto_connect: false
    on_numeric_comparison_request:
      then:
        - ble_client.numeric_comparison_reply:
            id: bru
            accept: true
```

See the [README]({docs_url}) for details. When the proxy is ready: on the tea maker, open **Machine setup → Pair new device**. Then press **Submit**.

locked_out.title: Try again
locked_out.description:
The tea maker may refuse new attempts for a few minutes. If this one fails too, wait about {minutes} min.

On the tea maker, open **Machine setup → Pair new device**. Then press **Submit**.

pair_failed.title: Pairing failed
pair_failed.description: On the tea maker, open **Machine setup → Pair new device**. Then press **Submit** to try again.

progress.pairing:
Connecting to **{name}**…

When a code appears on the tea maker, press **yes** there.
progress.waiting_for_device: Waiting for **{name}** to accept the code…

error.pair_rejected: The tea maker did not accept the pairing.
error.pair_rejected_proxy: The tea maker did not accept the pairing. If no code appeared, set up the proxy as described in the README: {docs_url}
